answer: Each identity enrolls a gait signature: the phone's motion sensors record how its owner walks across a marble floor - stride length, sway and cadence, as regular as a sonnet's meter yet unique to each body. Every epoch the network issues a fresh nonce walk: ten steps, signed and matched against the enrolled template. A farm scripting a hundred puppets hits a reef of distinct gaits - one operator cannot walk a hundred phones at once, and replayed samples die on the nonce. Mismatched gaits collapse to one vote and burn stake; an honest user just takes a short walk.
